method: Candidates came from (a) known CEO/NEO moves 2015-2025 and (b) EDGAR full-text searches of 8-K Item 5.02 announcements for phrases such as 'most recently served as Chief Executive Officer of', 'previously served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of', and 'Chief Financial Officer of <company>' / 'Chief Executive Officer of <company>' for companies whose stock fell. Every fact was then checked in filings only (no news): the A-company stock test uses A's 10-K Item 5 performance-graph table or proxy pay-versus-performance TSR, B's pay uses B's proxy Summary Compensation Table, and tenure/exit dates use 8-Ks and proxies. A case qualifies when a tabulated window whose base date and end point both fall inside the person's CEO/NEO tenure at A shows a loss of at least 40% or a shortfall of at least 50 points against an index or peer group in the same table, and the person became CEO/NEO of a US-listed B within 3 years of leaving A. To avoid cherry-picked windows, a case was rejected if a longer or earlier in-tenure table window in A's own filings showed outperformance or fell below the threshold. Cases were also rejected when tables were image-only, row labels were missing, or B's pay appeared only outside a proxy. Quotes are verbatim from bt.text.document_text output (whitespace normalized). Exit pay is recorded only where a filing quantifies it.
